verdict.rationale: Three.js has no official language server, and its own maintainer explicitly declines to maintain first-party TypeScript typings — community support relies on the third-party @types/three package, which has documented signature mismatches with the actual library requiring @ts-ignore workarounds. This gives editors some completion/diagnostic support via community types, but not an official, agent-attachable LSP or first-party typed API. Missing for 10: an official LSP, first-party maintained TS definitions, and confirmation that navigation/diagnostics work reliably without manual workarounds.
